item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The segment records presidential statutory determinations that establish legal predicates for duty modifications; those determinations occurred before the later tariff changes rather than directing an agency to decide their outcome.","evidence":"the President determined, pursuant to that section, that the article was a tropical agricultural or forestry commodity"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination that the specified tariff treatment is required or appropriate, a legally consequential predicate for the proclamation's tariff action.","evidence":"I determine that the modification or continuance of existing duties or other import restrictions and the continuance of existing duty-free or excise treatment hereinafter proclaimed are required or appropriate"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory finding required for suspension of the marking proviso, rather than instructing an agency to reach that finding later.","evidence":"I find that the suspension of the effectiveness of the proviso to Section 304(a) (3) (J)"},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The proclamation itself makes specified tariff treatments effective and modifies the Tariff Schedules on a fixed date, directly changing binding import duties and treatment.","evidence":"the Tariff Schedules of the United States are modified, effective on and after January 1, 1968"}]}
